summary: Deal and relationship management CRM for investment banks, private equity, and other financial firms (Intapp).
access_note: Customer-only: API access is enabled per user by the customer's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager inside a licensed tenant; no self-serve sandbox found.
blocker_note: Enterprise product; no public signup, API enabled only inside licensed customer tenants.

evidence.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token
Scroll down to the API Key section and click Enable
If you do not see the Admin section, contact your organization's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager (CSM) for assistance.
Required when accessing the Data or Schema API endpoints (api/rest/v4/data or api/rest/v4/schema).
DealCloud provides a default MCP Server out-of-the-box without any configuration required.

notes: Gating is inferred: MCP needs a DealCloud Celeste license and admin-enabled capabilities; API keys need an admin to enable API in the user group. No page explicitly says the docs are customer-only. MCP endpoint is per tenant.

review.reason: Endpoint is per tenant (https://[tenant].my.intapp.com/mcp/celeste/DealCloud); the previous URL (api.docs.dealcloud.com/mcp) was the docs hub, not an endpoint. Getting-started page documents the format.
